description: This file manages registration and lookup of symbolic functions for ONNX export in PyTorch, including handling different opset versions, custom functions, and decorators for registration.

classes.name: OverrideDict
classes.description: A dictionary that merges built-in and custom symbolic functions, supporting overriding and un-overriding.

classes.name: _SymbolicFunctionGroup
classes.description: Manages different versions of symbolic functions registered under the same name, supporting delayed registration and custom overrides.

classes.name: SymbolicRegistry
classes.description: Maintains a registry mapping function names to groups of symbolic functions, allowing registration, unregistration, and lookup.

methods.name: _dispatch_opset_version
methods.description: Finds the appropriate registered opset version based on target and available versions.

methods.name: set_base
methods.description: Sets a base symbolic function for a given key.

methods.name: in_base
methods.description: Checks if a key is in the base dictionary.

methods.name: override
methods.description: Overrides a base key-value with a new function.

methods.name: remove_override
methods.description: Removes a custom override for a given opset.

methods.name: overridden
methods.description: Checks if a key has an override.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves a function for a given opset.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets a function for a given opset, with default fallback.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a symbolic function for a specific opset.

methods.name: add_custom
methods.description: Adds a custom symbolic function for a specific opset.

methods.name: get_min_supported
methods.description: Returns the lowest opset version supported by the functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a symbolic function under a qualified name and opset, with optional custom flag.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a custom symbolic function for a given name and opset.

methods.name: get_function_group
methods.description: Retrieves the function group for a given name.

methods.name: is_registered_op
methods.description: Checks if an op is registered for a specific version.

methods.name: onnx_symbolic
methods.description: Decorator to register a symbolic function for specified opsets, with optional decorators and custom flag.

methods.name: custom_onnx_symbolic
methods.description: Decorator to register a custom symbolic function for specified opsets.
